prompt:
Minecraft builder reference sheet, landscape 3:2, crisp vanilla Minecraft voxel style, plain light background, no characters or animals. Two views side by side: LEFT straight-on front elevation, orthographic; RIGHT three-quarter front-right view at the same scale. Show the same complete building in both views, including pavement and a glimpse of the rear yard in the right view. Skilled human builder quality: substantial massing, depth, projections and recessed framed openings, buildable block-grid geometry, real roof verges, eaves and ridge, stairs/slabs/fences/walls/trapdoors/lantern detail.

Site: Victorian high-street shop row in warm red bricks with pale Bath-stone dressings made from sandstone. Width 24 blocks plus chimney breasts, depth 18 blocks, three storeys (ground shops plus two flat storeys) and a mansard. Street along the front, smooth stone pavement, grey andesite kerb. Two ground-floor shops with counters opening directly onto the pavement beneath one long horizontal opening, with only a central stone console dividing the shop fascias. Deep green fascia boards, white banner letters spelling "BAKER" and "GROCER". Stone consoles between fascias, stone pilasters at ends. Each outer end has a dark-oak bracket carrying a hanging sign. Projecting stone cornice across entire row above shops. Two projecting stone-framed oriel bay windows, one centered over each shop, each rising continuously through BOTH flat storeys, three-pane glazing on each floor. Tall narrow sash windows flank each oriel. Stone string course, sills and lintels, paired cut-stone corner quoins. On the right, narrower stair bay: double dark-oak front door, glazed fanlight, stone surround, slab hood, small "FLATS" sign. Dark-slate mansard roof with steep lower slopes and flatter upper section, dentilled stone eaves cornice, iron-bar crest, two dormers aligned over the oriels. Exactly three brick chimney stacks, on end walls and at back, stone bands and caps, two with smoke from concealed campfires supported by hay blocks. Rear cobbled yard, brick boundary walls, dark-oak gates and keeper doors.

Use only these exact vanilla Minecraft block ids, with their native pixel textures and forms:
walls: bricks, brick_stairs, brick_slab, brick_wall.
trim: smooth_sandstone, smooth_sandstone_stairs, smooth_sandstone_slab, cut_sandstone.
fascia: dark_prismarine, dark_prismarine_slab.
base: polished_andesite, polished_andesite_stairs, polished_andesite_slab.
roof: deepslate_tiles, deepslate_tile_stairs, deepslate_tile_slab, deepslate_tile_wall, iron_bars.
glass: glass_pane.
joinery: dark_oak_door, dark_oak_fence, dark_oak_fence_gate, dark_oak_trapdoor, dark_oak_planks.
floors: oak_planks, smooth_stone, oak_stairs.
ground: grass_block, dirt, stone, andesite, cobblestone.
functional/decor objects: white_banner, white_wall_banner, dark_oak_hanging_sign, dark_oak_wall_sign, hay_block, campfire, lantern, ladder.
Use white banner patterns for fascia lettering, never smooth arbitrary typography on the facade. Small reference-sheet captions LEFT FRONT ELEVATION and RIGHT THREE-QUARTER are allowed outside the build. Keep both views equally detailed and legible. No extra materials, no furniture or vegetation added, no artistic post-processing, no realistic curved or beveled architecture.
changes: Saved the built-in image-generation output unchanged as concept.png in the current directory.
Block identifications are visual interpretations: generated concept art does not encode exact Minecraft block ids. The roles retain every planned block; added ids approximate visible forms.

Sandstone trim includes carved bands and slender rounded columns, approximated by chiseled_sandstone, cut_sandstone_slab and sandstone_wall; some ornament cannot be reproduced exactly with vanilla blocks.
Chimneys have orange-brown pots beyond the planned palette, approximated by terracotta and flower_pot.

Shop interiors contain added wooden shelves, counters and small yellow and white merchandise. Dark-oak stairs and slabs approximate the furniture; hay_block, yellow_wool and white_wool approximate the displays, whose individual forms are not identifiable vanilla blocks.
The fascia lettering and hanging-sign symbols appear as custom graphic glyphs rather than clearly reproducible vanilla banner patterns.
Window glazing has pale sash muntins and finer divisions than simple three-pane glass_pane assemblies.
The right view shows three smoking chimneys rather than the requested two; campfires are inferred from smoke, with neither the fires nor supporting hay blocks visible.
The shops have separate framed openings divided by a substantial central pier rather than one uninterrupted long horizontal opening.
A cobbled side passage and boundary gates are visible, but the complete rear yard and keeper doors are not demonstrated.
The 24-block width and 18-block depth cannot be verified from the drawing, and equal scale between views is approximate.
The rendering uses fine brickwork, beveled details and curved ornament beyond a strict vanilla voxel grid.
Grass, dirt and a ladder are not visibly identifiable. Other retained plan blocks may be concealed or unused.
